page_title: AI Product Photo & Video Generator for Ads

sources.entry: Alimvo - AI product photo and video generator for ecommerce brands. Create studio shots, lifestyle scenes, and ad creatives in minutes. #freemium

summary.name: Alimvo
summary.one_liner: Alimvo is an AI tool for creating product photos, ad creatives, social posts, and short product videos for ecommerce brands.
use_cases: Creating studio product photos for ecommerce listings
Producing lifestyle scenes for product marketing
Making short video ads for social media
Turning raw product shots into campaign creatives
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a single workflow for producing AI product photos, ad creatives, social posts, and short product videos. Listing text says it can create studio shots, lifestyle scenes, and ad creatives in minutes. Testimonials mention retouching product images and exporting short ad videos within the same workflow. The page itself gives no detailed feature list, pricing, or technical specifications.
notable: Covers product photos, ad creatives, social posts, and short videos in one workflow
Claims studio shots and lifestyle scenes generated in minutes
Page is multilingual in its testimonials, suggesting an international user base
caveats: Pricing tiers and limits are not stated on the page; 'freemium' comes from the directory listing
Page content is mostly marketing and testimonials with few concrete specifications
